mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact the S&P 500 over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive, but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in unemployment rate suggests a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate drops below 3.5%, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both industrial production and housing starts increase, it indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Both industrial production and housing starts increase, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates may negatively impact the S&P 500 over 20 days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate increases, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer prices may lead to inflation concerns, negatively impacting the S&P 500 in the short term.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5% in a month
failure_condition: CPI increases by 0.5%, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real disposable income suggests reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Real disposable income decreases by 2%, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When employment increases and unemployment decreases, it indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: Employment increases and unemployment decreases, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest rate regime, decreasing federal funds rates may stimulate the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate decreases by 0.25%, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.
